name: Phantasmal Success
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (see text); Spell Resistance yes

The next time the subject attempts an action that requires a die roll to determine success, they must make a Will save or the action fails. However, the subject sees a phantasmal image of their success. The subject then acts as though they succeeded for 1 round, over which time the subject realizes they were fooled. They must then make another Will save or take a -4 penalty on attack rolls, saves, ability checks and skill checks for 1d6+1 rounds thereafter.

If you are using the hope and despair rules from Good Hope – Crushing Despair by Orphaned Bookworm Productions, phantasmal success gains the despair descriptor and the subject is hopeless for 1d4 rounds, then despairing for 1 round and doubting for 1 round after that. These conditions are instead of the listed penalties.
